name: Web Express
summary: Brisbane dialup ISP (8c/hour, web authoring, home page hosting, ~1997); defunct.

events.details: Website gone (no live site) — genuine ISP site last seen Feb 2012; bare 'Index of /' by Apr 2013.

refs.label: Still a genuine ISP page in Feb 2012.
By Apr 2013 the site is just a directory listing; cPanel 'suspendedpage.cgi' follows in 2014, then 'Southern Ocean Systems - Coming Soon' by 2021.
